title: Network Commerce Protocol: 1,500 cr once, a link after The Collective Provides; five carbon ore bought at Node Beta and sold at Central Nexus
note: 2026-11-22 03:45 UTC (Mercury, rule F35: every Voidborn mastery mission, each chain to its end; orders.log ENT-061 block MERCURY: missions that pay the trader's skills). Central Nexus board, Exchange Node Sigma (data/missions/central_nexus.json, 03:42 UTC): sell 5 carbon ore on the exchange; rewards 1,500 cr, trading 20, voidborn mastery 15 and piloting 20 XP. The board offers it after The Collective Provides (voidborn-collective-provides, its note), booked by 17 traders. Node Beta asks carbon ore 4 x 136,788 and Central Nexus bids 8 x 39 (table books, 03:37 UTC): five units cost about 20 cr and sell for about 40. The reserve, short of carbon ore, loses nothing: an empty hold, and the run sells only the five it buys. A test: one ship first (rules F12, F37), then two more; once per pilot. 2026-11-22 04:02 UTC (fill.py, Mercury): max_ships 1 -> 3.
